values.meaning: duration the Oathsworn is held before being released
values.quote: to retrieve and hold her ''Oathsworn'' for 4 seconds
values.binNote: No matching data value exists in the R slot's bin; only KnockupDuration is listed there. This 4-second hold duration is stated only in the wiki description text with no corresponding sheet entry.

mechanics.claim: Fate's Call renders the Oathsworn invulnerable and untargetable while held, so they cannot take damage during this period.
mechanics.quote: renders them {{tip|invulnerable}} and {{tip|untargetable}} for the duration

mechanics.claim: The Oathsworn's dash on landing knocks up nearby enemies, but the ability itself deals no damage.
The cooldown starts on cast, not on the ability's resolution.
